messages.content:
I drove for about an hour just now with this model, lateral only. It wasn’t great, but maybe better than v4. 

It sometimes seemed to wander around in the lane. A few times, I thought I would have to take control but it corrected itself just before I did. I kept my Planplus control value at 1 (default) and didn’t test with this value increased.

It was sometimes pretty timid with lane changes and sometimes it would get halfway through a lane change and then give up and return to the original lane, sort of like what we saw with Planplus.

I wasn’t able to get it to take any 90° turns, even ones that WMI is able to take easily. It sometimes started the turn and then straightened out the wheel halfway through the turn.

I felt like v4 would sometimes make some really sketchy maneuvers in curves and stuff, and I didn’t really notice that as much with this model. So maybe a step in the right direction?

Lateral it’s much smoother then v4 but not that smart , long it’s a mess rubber banding and too big of a  gap following distance .
I’ve been posting about the big following gap on comma channel but they don’t even read my comments anymore 😁
After messing around with OPM, I went back to CD210 to celebrate 0.11 release and God it’s still so good. Until OPM long and lat is fixed, CD210 is the gold standard e2e long model
tbh I have to use offset on cd210 or else my model hugs left bad
but besides that lateral is decent on it
Naaah, it's not good for me... Randomly hugs left or right. Back to cd210.

At low speeds lateral was very aggressive, commanding larger steering movements when driving around parked cars. It wanted to stay closer to the curb on residential streets, but closer to the middle line on 2 lane roads. Overall wasn’t crazy about lateral. Exp mode successfully stopped at all red lights I hit, but then had the repeated creep forward that so many other models have.
Thoughts on v4 vs v5?
I honestly can’t remember in detail, have tried so many models lately lol. Also I’m testing this on the Rav4 since it has steer to 0 and better brake tuning than the civic.

They felt pretty similar, both ping ponged for me, long was great though.

I’m currently using macrostiff as a daily with the v0 torque tune because its combo of lat and long work great for my trip
